description: This file declares the PidFd class which provides an interface for managing process file descriptors, launching subprocesses, and halting process hierarchies within a sandbox environment in the context of Android's Cuttlefish project.
external_methods: absl::StatusOr<PidFd> PidFd::LaunchSubprocess(absl::Span<const std::string>, std::vector<std::pair<sapi::file_util::fileops::FDCloser, int>>, absl::Span<const std::string>)

classes.name: PidFd
classes.description: A class that manages process file descriptors, enabling process launch, access, and termination within the sandbox environment.

methods.name: FromRunningProcess
methods.description: Returns a managed pidfd for a process identified by its pid if it is still running.

methods.name: LaunchSubprocess
methods.description: Launches a subprocess with the specified arguments, file descriptors, and environment, returning a pidfd for the new process.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID associated with this pidfd.

methods.name: AllFds
methods.description: Copies file descriptors from the target process into the current process context.

methods.name: Argv
methods.description: Retrieves the argument vector of the process.

methods.name: Env
methods.description: Retrieves the environment variables of the process.

methods.name: HaltHierarchy
methods.description: Terminates the process and all of its descendants.

methods.name: HaltChildHierarchy
methods.description: Terminates all descendant processes of the process.

methods.name: SendSignal
methods.description: Sends a specified signal to the process.
